title: CPD: 14.1% of Filipinos still use traditional family planning

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — About 14.1 percent of Filipinos still rely on traditional family planning methods such as withdrawal and the calendar method despite the steady rise in modern contraceptive use, the Commission on Population and Development (CPD) said Thursday. Mylin Mirasol Quiray, chief of the CPD Information Management and Communications Division, said the share of traditional-method users declined from 16.5 percent in 2022 but remained significant. “The use of traditional methods like withdrawal and the calendar is also declining. In 2022, it was 16.5 percent, and then in 2025, it was 14.1 percent. But if we translate that into absolute numbers, […]...
